rykte_runorna_sover.text: The runes in the forest sleep. But they dream.

rykte_portalen_oppen.text: Someone has woken the runes. The Red Portal stands open at the heart of the forest.

rykte_vargarna_okar.text: There are more wolves every night.

rykte_ulvhild_dod.text: The Greybear of Wolfstead is dead. They say Hedda wept for joy.

rykte_gravargsledaren.text: A grey wolf with a chain around its neck leads the packs.

rykte_skelett_vid_rosena.text: Skeletons have been seen by the cairns to the north.

rykte_flyktingens_sandaler.text: A child fled toward Wolfstead in new sandals. He never got there.

rykte_benviskaren.text: A hermit whispers to bones by a cairn in the northwest.

rykte_benkungen.text: Chieftain Valdemar wears a crown that binds the whole village.

rykte_benkungen_dod.text: The Bone King has fallen. The dead of the Old Village lie still.

rykte_gravvaktarens_arv.text: The Gravewardens' gear still lies where they fell.

rykte_byn_vaknar.text: People are moving back to the Old Village. It smells of bread again.

rykte_vakter_i_byn.text: The village has guards now. Farmers with spears, but they hold.

rykte_runsmidd_klinga.text: The smith who forged the Runeforged Blade died that same night.

rykte_askeborg_brinner.text: Ashenhold still burns, thirty years on.

rykte_dimmerstrand.text: The bells of Mistshore toll beneath the water.

rykte_trasdrottningen_dod.text: The mist over Mistshore has lifted. The bells have fallen silent.

rykte_korpmodern.text: The ravens on the rooftops wait for their mother.

rykte_spinnmodern.text: Something vast is weaving in the depths of Copperfell.

rykte_jarnmunkens_gordel.text: The strongest brother wore an iron girdle with a lock.

rykte_smittan_sprider_sig.text: The Blight is spreading. A bite that turns green is a death sentence.

rykte_askeborg_ljus.text: Someone has seen light in Ashenhold again. Not fire. Something else.

rykte_askfursten.text: Morvath sits in the ruined cathedral and simply burns.

rykte_askfursten_dod.text: The Ash Prince has fallen. For the first time in thirty years, rain fell on Ashenhold.

rykte_fjarde_stenen.text: They say there was a fourth runestone. It lies on the Rift's Floor.

rykte_legendariskt_hittat.text: Folk say {hjalte} carries {foremal}. No one has seen the like in thirty years.

rykte_hjalten.text: {hjalte} has slain {antal_bossar} of the lords of darkness. People are starting to hope.

rykte_mira_vet.text: Little Mira has stopped waiting by the road. She helps Sigrun now.

rykte_mira_hoppas.text: Little Mira says someone saw her brother in Wolfstead. She wants to go there.

rykte_viskaren_tyst.text: The Whisperer sits by Ylva's fire now. He whispers no more.

rykte_viskaren_skrattar.text: The Whisperer laughs at night. He says the skull has chosen.

rykte_hedda_palsen.text: Ulvhild's pelt hangs in Hedda's hunting lodge. She sleeps through the night now.

rykte_bror_begraver.text: Bror buried his son in the bear's pelt. There is a new cross by the camp.

rykte_ristaren_sanning.text: Ylva says the Runecarver snuffed out the Fourth Stone himself. She talks of lighting it again.

rykte_ristaren_hjalte.text: Ylva tells of the Runecarver, a hero who died in battle.

rykte_kronikan_ebbe.text: Ebbe reads the Gravewardens' Chronicle to the children by the portal.

rykte_kronikan_ingrid.text: Captain Ingrid wears her grandfather's Gravewarden crest. The guards drill every dawn now.

rykte_valdemar_vilar.text: Valdemar rests in the chieftain's grave with his signet. The graveyard is still.

rykte_valdemar_signet.text: {hjalte} wears the chieftain's signet. Some say the village has a new chieftain.

rykte_valdemar_sara.text: Sara Bonereader has built an altar from Valdemar's bones. Ebbe refuses to enter the chapel.

rykte_ebbe_dod.text: Ebbe the Gravewarden was found dead by the portal, his lantern dark. Ingrid guards the gate now.
